title: Countable cellularity of arbitrary products via finite subproducts
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: An arbitrary product of topological spaces satisfies the countable chain condition (CCC) whenever every finite subproduct does. For nonempty factors this is an equivalence. The proof includes an indexed uncountable delta-system lemma that permits repeated finite supports, and glues compatible cylinders over a finite common root. Arbitrary products of separable spaces are consequently CCC, without a cardinal bound or separation assumptions and allowing empty factors.
